audit.why: Poppy 48.04% over 791 games — a losing lane, and EVEN 6/10 is generous but defensible given Poppy's clean 2-3 window. Sion owns 4-5 and everything after items.
audit.corrected: Difficulty left; the chart now carries the Sion-favoured shape instead.

audit.whatIsWrong: Four rows disagreed with both the packet and their own whys: rows 1 and 2 said Sion while the whys describe Poppy's wall-stun window, row 3 said Skill while whys[3] says 'he out-trades you straight up here', row 4 said Skill while whys[4] calls the R cancel 'your one window to flip a fight'.
audit.why: Packet levelChart is Skill/Poppy/Poppy/Sion/Poppy/Sion/Sion and matches the written reasoning row for row.
audit.corrected: Rows 1, 2, 3 and 4 flipped in both layers as one group, with ratings adjusted.

audit.whatIsWrong: Three kit errors. (1) 'W deletes his dash' and 'W any dash he tries' — Sion has no dash. (2) 'bank W to interrupt his charged Q' — Steadfast Presence has no interrupt; it only stops dashes. (3) Sion's E was called a shield-break; Roar of the Slayer is an 800-range shockwave that slows and shreds armour, while the shield detonation is Soul Furnace's reactivation.
audit.why: The page was telling the user to save a 20s cooldown for an interrupt that does not exist, and mislabelling which spell shreds their armour before a trade.
audit.corrected: W restated as the armour/MR steroid plus move speed used to step out of the Decimating Smash arc; Roar of the Slayer named as the armour shred; Soul Furnace named as the shield whose reactivation deals the magic damage. Keeper's Verdict's displacement interrupting the Q charge is kept — that one is real.

audit.whatIsWrong: Itemization said stack Thornmail/Frozen Heart, but Glory in Death and Soul Furnace both deal damage based on your maximum health.
audit.why: Flagged missing interaction 'resistances-invalidated': raw armour is the wrong answer against max-health damage.
audit.corrected: Item line re-pointed at health and anti-heal, with the reason stated.

audit.whatIsWrong: Decimating Smash was tracked with no number and no charge condition.
audit.why: 10/9/8/7/6s, and only a long enough charge knocks up and stuns — a short release is just damage.
audit.corrected: Both written into the cooldown lines.

edits.after: Track Decimating Smash: 10s at rank 1, and only a near-full charge stuns. In that window — E-Q + R him.

edits.before: Start Doran's Shield + pot. Core: Iceborn Gauntlet  (the slow engine), then Thornmail / Frozen Heart; boots Plated Steelcaps. Add anti-heal (Thornmail component early) — his healing fights your grind.
edits.after: Start Doran's Shield + pot. Core: Iceborn Gauntlet (the slow engine), then health over raw armour — his passive and Soul Furnace both scale off your max health. Anti-heal early: the zombie passive heals off every auto.

edits.before: His passive zombie state and tankiness mean you can never fully kill him; he scales into an unkillable frontline you only chip.

edits.before: Sion's whole early game is the charged Q — a long wind-up knockup that, fully charged, stuns you for ages. Don't sit in front of him while he charges it; sidestep or walk into him to cancel it short. Your level 2-3 window is real: E him into a wall when his Q is down for a stun, then Q for the max-HP chunk. Just respect that his W shield eats your Q and his E (shield-break) pokes you for free when you walk up to last-hit.
edits.after: Sion's whole early game is Decimating Smash — a long wind-up that only knocks up and stuns near full charge. Don't stand in the arc while he charges; step out or walk through him. Your level 2-3 window is real: E him into a wall on that 10s cooldown for a stun, then Q for the max-HP chunk. Respect that Soul Furnace (W) shields off your Q, and Roar of the Slayer (E) shreds your armour from 800 range as you walk up.

edits.before: Levels 4-5 swing his way — his Q charge scales hard and his W shield gets bigger, so he out-trades your flat damage if you facecheck the knockup. At 6 you steal a window back: your R (Keeper's Verdict) can cancel his charged Q mid-cast and displace him out of his own all-in, or peel when he flashes Q onto you. Use W to deny nothing dash-wise here (he has none) — bank it instead to interrupt his charge. Bait the Q, dodge it, then E-wall punish the long cooldown.
edits.after: Levels 4-5 swing his way — his Q charge scales hard and Soul Furnace gets bigger, so he out-trades your flat damage if you facecheck the knockup. At 6 you steal a window back: Keeper's Verdict displaces him out of a Decimating Smash charge and out of his own all-in, or peels when he Flashes the Q onto you. W has no dash to eat here, so use it as the armour/MR steroid and the move speed that walks you out of his arc.

edits.before: Hold W to body-block nothing here — instead bank it to interrupt his charged Q knockup when he commits
edits.after: Treat W as pure armour/MR and move speed here — it is how you walk out of the Decimating Smash arc

edits.before: Use W shield to eat your Q poke and break it for the bonus E magic poke as you walk up
edits.after: Shield off your Q with Soul Furnace, then detonate it for max-health magic damage

notes: Packet defect 'never names any of Sion's abilities' is now partly addressed — Decimating Smash, Soul Furnace, Roar of the Slayer and Glory in Death appear by name. Two false mechanics removed: Poppy's W does not interrupt Sion's Q charge (it only stops dashes, and Sion has none), and Sion's E is an armour-shredding shockwave, not a shield-break. Itemization re-pointed off raw armour per the resistances-invalidated flag. Level chart rows 1-4 flipped in matched pairs to match both the packet and their own whys.
